row.scim_plan: Plan not published (Okta-only beta app, enabled by Support)
row.evidence: Splunk On-Call documents "Single Sign-on using SAML and SCIM 2.0 user provisioning" only through the Okta "VictorOps (Beta)" app, which Support must activate.
row.notes: Status moved from gated to partial. SCIM 2.0 provisioning exists only through Okta's VictorOps (Beta) app (create, deactivate, reactivate; profile updates not supported), activated by a Support ticket, so it works with exactly one IdP. No first-party page now states the plan or price that SCIM needs. June's Enterprise $25/u/mo (annual) and $45/u/mo (monthly) figures and the Starter label on the price have no first-party source today and were dropped: Splunk's pricing page shows only 'Starting at just $5 per user, per month, billed annually for up to 10 seats'. The API docs name the packages Starter, Growth and Enterprise. SAML SSO docs say it is compatible with the 'full-stack version' and is set up via Support. Team plan is assumed to be the entry Starter package at the listed starting price.

plans.name: Starter
plans.price_text: Starting at $5 per user per month, billed annually, for up to 10 seats
plans.notes: The pricing page does not name the tier; the API docs list Starter, Growth and Enterprise packages.

auth.token_source: Integrations > 3rd Party Integrations > Okta > Enable Integration (Revoke Token to rotate)

operations.notes: Okta app enables only Create Users and Deactivate Users; profile updates are not supported. Group push not listed.

deprovision.data_retained: User contact methods not in Okta, push-device registrations, paging policies, team and rotation membership are permanently deleted; user is replaced in rotations, escalation policies and overrides.

attributes.notes: Email is the only supported username format; Splunk On-Call matches users on the primary email.

limitations.text: Beta, Okta-only; setup is not self-service and requires a Support ticket.
Updates to user profile attributes, including username, are not supported; workaround is delete and re-create the user in Okta.
Deprovisioning fails if the user is the only member of a team or the last Global Admin, or no replacement can be found.

auth.notes: X-VO-Api-Id and X-VO-Api-Key headers; only admins can create API keys.

endpoints.purpose: Remove a user from the organisation (with replacement)

rate_limits.text: Most user and team endpoints: 2 calls per second; batch user add: 1 call per second. All packages have unlimited API calls.

okta.notes: Two OIN apps: VictorOps (SAML, SWA, no provisioning) and VictorOps (Beta) (SAML, SWA, SCIM Create and Deactivate).

fallbacks.notes: Standard SAML SSO links existing Splunk On-Call users through a one-time linking step; JIT creation is not documented.
